description: This Java source file defines the FineractErrorDecoder class, which implements custom error decoding logic for handling API error responses in the Fineract client. It processes JSON error responses to extract messages and validation errors, and constructs appropriate exceptions.

classes.name: FineractErrorDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing Feign's ErrorDecoder to customize error handling for Fineract API responses.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the error response, parses JSON to extract error messages and validation errors, and returns a custom FeignException.

methods.name: readResponseBody
methods.description: Reads the response body into a byte array.

methods.name: extractField
methods.description: Extracts a specific field's text value from a JSON node.

methods.name: extractValidationErrors
methods.description: Aggregates validation error messages from the 'errors' array in the JSON response.
